messages:
Maya: Heads upI'm flying into SF next Monday with my mom who needs gluten-free options. Any dinner recs near Redwood (Market & 5th)? Quiet/kid-friendly would be ideal.
Josh: @Maya Rocco's Pizzeria has a GF crust if you call ahead. Kids usually love it. :pizza:
Priya: Blue Bird Kitchen (https://bluebird.example) has GF pasta and a chill patio. Staff is allergy-aware.
Liam: Leaf & Loaf on 6th is quieter, they do a GF saffron risotto and have early seating. Good for parents.
Emily: +1 Leaf & Loaf. Ask for the corner table, they can bring a high chair. Saffron risotto + roasted veg = win.
Tom: Market Dumplings nearby is casual, steamed rice bowls and GF-friendly sauces. Fast if you want to keep it low-key.
Maya: Amazing, thank you. Also—any breakfast spots open by 6:30am for an early flight?
Rachel: Sunrise Grind opens at 6am, great coffee and GF granola bowls. 4-min walk.
Josh: Bagel Barn at Embarcadero will do a GF bagel on request but only until 9am. Handy if you want something to-go.
Priya: Quick poll: kid-friendly/relaxed (Leaf & Loaf / Blue Bird / Market Dumplings) or slightly fancier (if mom wants table service)?
Maya: Kid-friendly, please.
Emily: Vote: Leaf & Loaf :thumbsup:
Liam: Vote: Fancy :tophat: (but not for this trip)
Tom: I can call Leaf & Loaf and request a corner table/high chair.
Maya: That would be great, thanks Tom.
Tom: Called and put a hold for Mon 6:30pm for 3 under "Maya". Confirmation #L8F-331. They confirmed GF options.
Maya: You're a lifesaver, thank you all! :heart:
Rachel: If you want dessert after, Sweet Harbor (2 blocks over) has a GF almond cake that's small-plate friendly.
Maya: Saving that one. Thanks again team! :tada:
